description: Rework the repo from a Next.js 14 starter into a Vite + React 18 + TypeScript SPA, and lay down the shared foundation: build config, global CSS design system (palette, fonts, base elements), typed data model, and an App shell that renders placeholder sections. Because the npm registry is blocked in this sandbox, everything is hand-authored; a developer with network runs 'npm install && npm run dev' locally to see it. This feature leaves the app structurally complete and typed even though it cannot be built in-sandbox.
steps: Remove Next.js scaffolding: delete next.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, tailwind.config.ts, .eslintrc.json, src/app/ (layout.tsx, page.tsx, globals.css, favicon.ico, fonts/). Keep the .git directory and public/ (svgs may be removed or left; not required).

Rewrite package.json for Vite: name stays 'sapphirebeautyspa', type 'module', scripts { dev: 'vite', build: 'tsc && vite build', preview: 'vite preview' }. dependencies: react ^18.3.1, react-dom ^18.3.1. devDependencies: @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.3.1, vite ^5.4.8, typescript ^5.6.2, @types/react ^18.3.11, @types/react-dom ^18.3.0. Ensure these versions are mutually compatible.
Create vite.config.ts at root using @vitejs/plugin-react (import { defineConfig } from 'vite'; import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react').

Rewrite tsconfig.json for a Vite React app: compilerOptions target ES2020, lib [ES2020, DOM, DOM.Iterable], module ESNext, moduleResolution 'bundler', jsx 'react-jsx', strict true, noEmit true, isolatedModules true, skipLibCheck true, resolveJsonModule true, allowImportingTsExtensions false. include ['src']. references to ./tsconfig.node.json. Also create tsconfig.node.json for the vite config file.
Update .gitignore: remove Next.js entries (.next, out, next-env.d.ts, .vercel), keep /node_modules, /dist, .DS_Store, npm-debug logs, *.local. Ensure node_modules and dist are ignored.

Create index.html at repo root: lang='en', charset, viewport, a descriptive Sapphire Beauty Studio | Cedar Rapids, Iowa, meta description, preconnect + Google Fonts for Playfair Display (600,700) and DM Sans (400,500,600,700), a
, and . Add smooth scrolling note.
Create src/main.tsx: React 18 createRoot rendering <App/> in StrictMode, importing './styles/global.css'.

Create src/styles/global.css: define :root CSS variables for the palette (--navy #0B2348, --cream #F7F2EB, --beige #E9DDD0, --taupe #D7C2AD, --ink #242321, --white #FFFDF9), font family vars (--font-serif: 'Playfair Display', serif; --font-sans: 'DM Sans', sans-serif). Add CSS reset/normalize basics, box-sizing border-box, body defaults (background cream, ink text, sans font, line-height), h1-h6 use serif, a reusable .container max-width ~1200px with responsive padding, section vertical rhythm, html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top for sticky header }, accessible :focus-visible outline using navy, reusable button/link classes (.btn, .btn-primary navy bg / cream text, .btn-outline thin border), .eyebrow small uppercase letter-spaced label style, thin border variables. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling transitions/scroll-behavior.

Create src/data/ typed arrays with clear 'TODO: replace with real client data/photography' comments. All image URLs must be tasteful Unsplash direct image URLs centralized here. Files: src/data/services.ts (5 categories: Lashes/Extensions,lifts & tinting; Brows/Shaping,tinting & lamination; Skin/Korean facials & custom treatments; Permanent Beauty/Brows,eyeliner & lip blush; Waxing + Beauty/Body waxing,makeup & more; each with id, name, descriptor, icon key, exploreUrl = 'https://sapphirebeautyia.glossgenius.com/services'). src/data/artists.ts (Colby Jordan / 'Founder · Esthetician · PMU Artist · Educator' / bio + isFounder true; Emi Abney / 'Independent Beauty Artist · Mirror Mirror'; Reegan Flugge / 'Independent Lash & Brow Artist'; each with name, role, bio, portrait URL, bookingUrl defaulting to 'https://sapphirebeautyia.glossgenius.com/', and a comment that individual booking URLs can be added later). src/data/gallery.ts (several items each with id, imageUrl, alt, category one of 'Lashes'|'Brows'|'Skin'|'PMU'). src/data/testimonials.ts (3 items: quote, rating number 1-5, attribution as generic placeholder e.g. 'Verified Client' - do NOT fabricate specific named identities; comment to replace with real reviews). src/data/faq.ts (5 items: How do I book?; How do I choose the right artist?; Where can I see current pricing and availability?; What is the cancellation policy?; How should I prepare for my appointment? - answers direct users to GlossGenius for pricing/availability/policy). Export a shared constant BOOKING_URL = 'https://sapphirebeautyia.glossgenius.com/' and SERVICES_URL = 'https://sapphirebeautyia.glossgenius.com/services' from a src/data/constants.ts and reuse everywhere.

Create src/App.tsx that imports and composes the section components in order (Header, Hero, Services, ArtistsSection, KBeautySection, Gallery, Testimonials, FAQ, ContactSection, Footer). For THIS feature, create minimal placeholder component stubs for any section not yet built so the app compiles and the structure is complete; later features will flesh them out. Ensure each section has the correct anchor id (home, services, artists, about, gallery, faq, contact).

Create a small reusable BookButton component (src/components/BookButton.tsx) that renders an <a> with target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer' to a given href (default BOOKING_URL), used by all booking CTAs across the site.
acceptance_criteria: No Next.js files remain (no next.config.mjs, no src/app/, no next dependency in package.json).
package.json declares Vite, React 18, react-dom 18, typescript 5, @vitejs/plugin-react, and correct scripts (dev/build/preview).
index.html references /src/main.tsx and loads Playfair Display + DM Sans from Google Fonts.
src/styles/global.css defines all six palette CSS variables with the exact hex values from the spec and serif/sans font variables.

src/data/ contains services, artists, gallery, testimonials, faq arrays plus constants.ts with BOOKING_URL and SERVICES_URL exactly matching the spec URLs, all with typed interfaces and TODO comments.
src/App.tsx composes all named sections with correct anchor ids and the project has no unresolved imports (every imported component/data file exists and is exported).
verification: Read src/App.tsx and confirm every imported component and data module resolves to an existing, exported file.
grep the codebase to confirm no remaining 'next' imports or next.config files.
Confirm global.css contains the exact palette hex values and that index.html links both Google Fonts.
Note in findings: 'npm install' and 'vite build' cannot be run in-sandbox due to blocked npm registry; local build expected to succeed.
findings: Reworked the Next.js 14 starter into a Vite 5 + React 18 + TypeScript 5 SPA. Removed next.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, tailwind.config.ts, .eslintrc.json, src/app/, and the Next.js public svgs. Authored: package.json (pinned react/react-dom ^18.3.1, vite ^5.4.8, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.3.1, typescript ^5.6.2, @types/react ^18.3.11, @types/react-dom ^18.3.0; scripts dev/build/preview), vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json + tsconfig.node.json, .gitignore, index.html (Google Fonts: Playfair Display 600/700 + DM Sans 400/500/600/700, preconnect, title, meta description, /src/main.tsx), src/main.tsx, src/vite-env.d.ts, src/styles/global.css (all six palette vars with exact hex #0B2348/#F7F2EB/#E9DDD0/#D7C2AD/#242321/#FFFDF9, serif/sans font vars, reset, .container, .section, .eyebrow, .btn/.btn-primary/.btn-outline, .link-arrow, focus-visible, skip-link, prefers-reduced-motion), src/data/{constants,services,artists,gallery,testimonials,faq}.ts (all typed with interfaces and TODO comments; BOOKING_URL='https://sapphirebeautyia.glossgenius.com/' and SERVICES_URL='https://sapphirebeautyia.glossgenius.com/services'), a reusable BookButton component (always target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer), placeholder section stubs (Header, Hero, Services, ArtistCard, ArtistsSection, KBeautySection, Gallery, Testimonials, FAQ, ContactSection, Footer), and src/App.tsx composing all sections with anchor ids home/services/artists/about/gallery/faq/contact (about lives on KBeautySection so the About nav link resolves). Rewrote README with local setup. Image URLs are centralized as tasteful Unsplash placeholders in data files and section stubs, each with TODO comments. VERIFICATION: could NOT run 'npm install'/'vite build'/'npm run dev' in-sandbox because the npm registry is blocked (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, HTTP 403) and node_modules cannot be installed; this is expected per context.json. Verified instead by reading files back: no remaining 'next' imports or config files; every App/component/data import resolves to an existing file with a matching export; all default exports present; all six palette hex values and both Google Fonts present; all 7 target=_blank links carry rel=noopener noreferrer; BookButton uses 'import type { ReactNode }' (react-jsx transform does not bring React namespace into scope for type refs), and all data type imports use 'import type' for isolatedModules compatibility. Local 'npm install && npm run dev' is expected to succeed. CAVEAT for later features: section components are minimal stubs referencing CSS classes not yet defined in global.css (e.g. .site-header, .hero, .artists__grid) - FEAT-002/003 should add those styles.
